title: LDAP Client Signing is Not Required (MitM Vulnerability)
description: LDAP client signing requires LDAP traffic to be digitally signed, preventing man-in-the-middle tampering and credential relay attacks.
impact: Unsigned LDAP queries transmitted across domain subnets can be intercepted and altered via ARP/LLMNR spoofing.

compliance_mappings.title: Network security: LDAP client signing requirements

title: Netlogon Secure Channel Encryption Weakened
description: Netlogon secure channel must mandate strong encryption and signing to protect domain computer account authentication (Zerologon defense).
impact: Adversaries can exploit unauthenticated Netlogon RPC connections to impersonate domain computer accounts.
remediation_guidance: Set RequireSignOrSeal and RequireStrongKey to 1 in HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Netlogon\Parameters.

compliance_mappings.title: Domain member: Digitally encrypt or sign secure channel data (always)
